rules: numbers, times, codes in mono with tabular-nums (tokens.css:138-141)

proposed.reuse: Use every extracted token name unchanged so one stylesheet serves Argus.

ticketState.note: State names are proposed; P6-T02 owns the real list. Only awaiting-qa and done are named in phases/P06-argus-flow.md:39,44.

phaseChips.source: PLAN.md:134-145 classDef fills, use as 18% tints behind the P-label

provenance.--badge-illustrative: diagonal hatch overlay + corner label ILLUSTRATIVE

screens.title: Run board
screens.purpose: Tickets by workflow state with wave/phase status and quota meter, so the owner sees what is stuck and whether quota allows another run.
actions: Run next (disabled with the refusing limit named)

states.empty: No tickets yet; show the bench command; counts are 0 not an em dash
states.error: red pill with message; keep last data
states.slow: amber stale pill + banner; Render cold start shown as 'service waking'
states.quotaExhausted: meter red; rows in quota-wait with reset time (UTC midnight); Run next disabled
states.stuckRun: non-terminal past timeout + grace shows stuck chip with age and a reaper action

edgeCases: fixture-host runs carry a permanent REPLAY badge and are excluded from live aggregates by default
UTC day roll mid-run (ledger.py:117-120)
duplicate webhook collapses to one row (P6-T06 SetWorkflowID(ticket_id))
model with no quota row is refused, shown as 'no quota row', not 0% (ledger.py:83, quotas.md:25)

quotaMeterReal.measured: partial: rpd and tpm from response headers, tpd and rpm published only (quotas.md:35)

usedToday.caveat: fixture replay, 2 tokens per call, not real usage

screens.title: Trajectory viewer
screens.purpose: Replay how the agent reached its answer: step timeline, tool calls, tokens, stop reason.
borrows: agent-builder run detail pre blocks and log lines

fields.name: steps[].stop_reason
fields.source: StopReason enum: submit, step-cap, token-cap, QuotaExceeded, stuck, consecutive-timeout, retry-cap, tool-unavailable

fields.name: derived: steps, tool-error rate, redundant-call rate, stuck rate, recover-after-gate-failure rate

states.loading: meta line first, steps stream in
states.empty: meta present, zero steps: Run started, no step recorded
states.error: schema validation path shown (extra=forbid), raw file download offered
states.quotaExhausted: last stop_reason QuotaExceeded; banner 'model would exceed limit: used of cap' (ledger.py:18-24)
states.stuckRun: stop_reason stuck or consecutive-timeout; highlight the repeated tool-call pair

edgeCases: fixture trajectories have one step with tokens_in=1, tokens_out=1: label REPLAY, token counts not real (runs/text-only/seed-e01/trajectory.jsonl)
tool_error set while stop_reason null
last step stop_reason null means live or crashed: check freshness
raw_response is untrusted page text: render as text only

screens.title: Verifier verdict review
screens.purpose: Human QA gate: before/after, four deterministic checks, judge label, approve or reject. Judge never overrides a passed check run (P04 goal line 6).

fields.name: scorer exit code 0 pass / 1 fail / 2 infra error
qa{decision approve|reject, reviewer, reason, idempotency_key, at}

states.loading: image placeholders with fixed aspect ratio
states.empty: Nothing waiting for QA; count of Decided
states.error: a check or image error renders as error, never pass (P4-T28)
states.slow: judge spinner with elapsed; approve enabled only when all four checks pass, judge shown as advisory pending (proposed rule)
states.quotaExhausted: hosted judge error (QuotaExceeded); local Ollama unaffected; decide on checks
states.stuckRun: awaiting-qa past QA timeout: timed-out-qa banner, Re-request review (P6-T08)

edgeCases: judge disagrees with passed checks: show label, verdict unchanged
alpha below 0.80: judge card says advisory only (ADR-013)
font-loading flake: re-run once, count reruns (P4-T26)
prompt injection in ticket text rendered as plain text (P4-T27)
409 already decided by another reviewer: show winner and decision
free-tier prompts may train: public/synthetic code banner on personal profile (PLAN.md:14)
missing before or after image: check error, not pass

screens.title: Eval, regression gate and quota ledger
screens.purpose: Show phase-over-phase resolve rate with intervals, tokens/bug, latency, the CI gate verdict, and the free-quota burn.
borrows: MyUsage stat tiles and UTC quota clock

fields.name: latency p50/p95, quota wait reported separately
run_id, model, host, prompt_hash, git_commit, seed
gate{status, rule, observed_lower, baseline_lower}
fields.source: PROPOSED from P5-T16; thresholds in ADR-017

fields.name: ledger per model requests, tokens, cached vs requests_per_day, tokens_per_day, requests_per_minute, tokens_per_minute, cached_counts

states.empty: empty results template, all cells em dash, banner: no run id backs any number yet
states.error: results JSON invalid: red pill, last good report kept
states.slow: static page: built-at commit and time, stale pill if older than latest results commit
states.quotaExhausted: model bar red 'QuotaExceeded at requests_per_day', next reset, partial results shown (P0 break-it 4)
states.stuckRun: ledger-active run with no event past grace: may be hung

edgeCases: P0 baseline cell shows -0.000000: clamp the lower bound at 0 (batch.py:126 clamps; phases/P00-argus-bench.md:85 does not)
tiny n (0/1 gives [0.000, 0.793]): difference smaller than interval is 'no difference' (PLAN.md:286)
mixed hosts in one table: split by host, never pool fixture with live
cached tokens not charged when cached_counts is false but still shown in cached column
Groq reset header is not a calendar-day boundary (quotas.md:11) while the ledger rolls on UTC date (ledger.py:117-120): show both
tokens_per_day and requests_per_minute are published, not measured: tag 'published'
